subject: unite issue resolved with duplicate lines with development version

messages.author: b5b1db21b60ddd4a
messages.subject: unite issue resolved with duplicate lines with development version
parts:
Dear all,

 

I had a two methylation profiles that were each ~3.5 million lines of data 901 lines were the same for chr start and stop, however differed in strand (as I had data for both strands for these 901 CGs).

Methylkit was installed as directed in the October 2013 manual. (methylKit 0.9.2, data.table data.table_1.9.2).

 

I had the following error message after the unite() function:

“Error in vecseq(f__, len__, if (allow.cartesian) NULL else as.integer(max(nrow(x),  :

  Join results in 3569187 rows; more than 3567385 = max(nrow(x),nrow(i)). Check for duplicate key values in i, each of which join to the same group in x over and over again. If that's ok, try including `j` and dropping `by` (by-without-by) so that j runs for each group to avoid the large allocation. If you are sure you wish to proceed, rerun with allow.cartesian=TRUE. Otherwise, please search for this error message in the FAQ, Wiki, Stack Overflow and datatable-help for advice.”

 

It was suggested to use the development version with the commands:

 

library(devtools)

install_github("methylKit", username = "al2na",ref = "development",build_vignettes=FALSE)

 

After inputting the above commands, which did successfully load, I then attempt to read the files as before and got the message:

 

Error: could not find function "read"

 

It was then suggested to add the command:

library(methylKit)

 

The files loaded and unite() worked, producing the correct number of lines of data.

 

So issue resolved.

 

Michelle

messages.author: e4181d5c40fc094c
messages.subject: Re: [methylkit_discussion] unite issue resolved with duplicate lines with development version
parts:
Dear Michelle,

Thanks for updating with the solved issue. The logic is pretty simple. When you have updated the methylKit, R has actually unloaded/detached the library and then updated it. To use any methylKit specific function, it need to be reloaded after the update!


Regards,
Kalyan
